# OverlayModules: ScreenRecord

> **File:** `components/content/ScreenRecord.qml` · **Schema:** `definitions.ScreenRecordOverlayModule` · **Label:** Screen recording
> **Annotations:** x-hosts=["overlay","edgeMenu","desktop"], x-icon="screen_record", x-libraryGroup="Tools", x-defaultSize=[4,4]

Settings are read as `properties.<key>`.

- **`directory`** · string = ""
  - Folder: Where recordings are saved and listed from (~ is your home). Empty uses Pictures/Screenshots, as screenshots do.
  - x-scope="machine", x-control="folder"
  - in: `components/content/ScreenRecord.qml`
- **`grow`** · integer = 0 · 0–16 · rows
  - Grow by up to: Rows it may take while its list needs them: free rows towards the edge first (above it, or below it in a bottom menu), then away from it, pushing the modules there along (not on the lock or login screen). 0 keeps it at its size.
  - in (generic, name match): `components/hosts/overlay/ModuleGrid.qml`, `components/hosts/popout/BarPopouts.qml`, `components/methods/EdgeAttach.qml`, `components/surfaces/edgemenu/EdgeMenuBody.qml`, `components/views/layouts/GridCanvas.qml`
